en.t: Sixty-five days after being exiled by the Emperor Maxentius to Sicily, Pope Eusebius dies
en.s: Marcus Aurelius Valerius Maxentius (c. 283 – 28 October 312) was a Roman emperor from 306 until his death in 312. Despite ruling in Italy and North Africa, and having the recognition of the Senate in Rome, he was not recognized as a legitimate emperor by his fellow emperors. He was the son of former Emperor Maximian and the son-in-law of Emperor Galerius.

zh.t: 被马克森提乌斯皇帝流放到西西里65天后，教宗欧西比乌斯去世
zh.s: 马库斯·奥列里乌斯·瓦莱里乌斯·马克森提乌斯（约283年—312年10月28日）于306年至312年去世期间担任罗马皇帝。尽管他统治意大利和北非，并获得罗马元老院承认，但其他皇帝并不承认他是合法皇帝。他是前任皇帝马克西米安之子，也是皇帝伽列里乌斯的女婿。

en.s: The Battle of Cuarte or Battle of Quart de Poblet was a military engagement that took place on 21 October 1094 between the forces of El Cid, ruler of the Principality of Valencia, and the Almoravid Empire under the command of Muhammad ibn Tashfin, near the towns of Mislata and Quart de Poblet, located a few kilometres from Valencia.

zh.s: 夸尔特战役又称夸尔特德波夫莱特战役，于1094年10月21日爆发，交战双方是瓦伦西亚公国统治者熙德率领的军队，以及穆罕默德·伊本·塔什芬指挥的阿尔摩拉维王朝军队。战斗地点在瓦伦西亚附近的米斯拉塔和夸尔特德波夫莱特两镇一带。

en.s: The Battle of Civetot was fought between the forces of the People's Crusade and of the Seljuk Turks of Anatolia on 21 October 1096. The battle brought an end to the People's Crusade; some of the survivors joined the First Crusade.

zh.s: 1096年10月21日，人民十字军与安纳托利亚的塞尔柱突厥军队在奇维托特交战。此战终结了人民十字军，部分幸存者加入了第一次十字军东征。

en.s: The siege of Antioch took place during the First Crusade in 1097 and 1098, on the Crusaders' way to Jerusalem through Syria. Two sieges took place in succession. The Crusaders sieged the city held by the Seljuk Empire from 20 October 1097 to 3 June 1098, when the Crusaders successfully took the city. A Seljuk relieving army then sieged the Crusaders for three weeks in late June.
en.n: First Crusade: Crusaders led by Godfrey of Bouillon, Bohemund of Taranto, and Raymond IV, Count of Toulouse, begin the Siege of Antioch.

zh.s: 安条克围城战发生于1097年至1098年第一次十字军东征期间，是十字军经叙利亚前往耶路撒冷途中发生的战事。围城战先后分为两段：十字军从1097年10月20日至1098年6月3日围攻塞尔柱帝国控制的城市，并于6月3日成功攻占。6月下旬，塞尔柱援军随后围困十字军三周。
zh.n: 第一次十字军东征期间，戈弗雷·德·布永、塔兰托的博希蒙德和图卢兹伯爵雷蒙四世率领的十字军开始围攻安条克。

en.s: The Battle of Martos was a minor battle of the Spanish Reconquista fought between Martos and Torredonjimeno in Andalusia in 1275. The battle was fought between the troops of the Kingdom of Granada and those of the Crown of Castile. The Castilian force was completely destroyed as a result of the battle. There is some confusion in the dates since different authors report different dates.

zh.s: 马尔托斯之战是西班牙收复失地运动期间的一场小规模战斗，1275年发生在安达卢西亚的马尔托斯与托雷东希梅诺之间。交战双方是格拉纳达王国军队和卡斯蒂利亚王室军队。卡斯蒂利亚军队在战斗中全军覆没。由于不同作者记载的日期不一，具体日期存在争议。

en.s: The siege of Akasaka was one of the earlier battles of the Genkō War between the figurehead Emperor Godaigo and the largely Hōjō-controlled Kamakura shogunate during the final years of the Kamakura period in Japan. The battle in question was fought at Shimo Akasaka-jō (下赤坂城, English: Lower Akasaka fortress), a fortress built upon Mount Yoshino near modern-day Osaka in the former Kawachi Province in Osaka Prefecture.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 赤坂围城战是元弘之乱早期的一场战斗。元弘之乱发生在日本镰仓时代末期，名义上的领导者是后醍醐天皇，实际对手是由北条氏掌控的镰仓幕府。战斗发生在下赤坂城。这座堡垒建于吉野山上，靠近今大阪地区，位于旧河内国。

en.s: The Battle of Auberoche was fought on 21 October 1345 during the Gascon campaign of 1345 between an Anglo-Gascon force of 1,200 men under Henry, Earl of Derby, and a French army of 7,000 commanded by Louis of Poitiers. It was fought at the village of Auberoche near Périgueux in northern Aquitaine. At the time, Gascony was a territory of the English Crown and the "English" army included a large proportion of native Gascons.

zh.s: 奥伯罗什战役于1345年10月21日爆发，属于1345年加斯科涅战役的一部分。交战双方是亨利·德比伯爵率领的1,200人英格兰—加斯科涅联军，以及路易·德·普瓦捷指挥的7,000人法国军队。战斗发生在北阿基坦佩里格附近的奥伯罗什村。当时加斯科涅是英王领地，“英格兰”军队中有很大一部分是当地加斯科涅人。

en.s: The siege of Nijmegen was a military engagement during the Eighty Years' War and the Anglo–Spanish War which took place from 17 to 21 October 1591. The Spanish garrison in Nijmegen was besieged by a Dutch and English force under Maurice of Nassau and Francis Vere respectively and surrendered soon.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 尼美亨围城战是八十年战争和英西战争期间的一场军事交战，发生于1591年10月17日至21日。毛里茨·范·奥兰治和弗朗西斯·维尔分别率领荷兰与英国联军围攻驻守尼美亨的西班牙军队，西班牙守军很快投降。

en.s: The Capture of Ootmarsum in 1597 was a short siege, that took place during the Eighty Years' War and the Anglo–Spanish War by a Dutch and English army led by Count Van Duivenvoorde while Maurice of Nassau was besieging Oldenzaal. The siege lasted from 19 to 21 October, where the Spanish garrison of Ootmarsum under the governor, Otto Van Den Sande, surrendered and was then occupied by the besiegers.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1597年奥特马瑟姆攻占战是八十年战争和英西战争期间的一场短暂围城战。当毛里茨·范·奥兰治围攻奥尔登扎尔时，范·杜伊文福尔德伯爵率领荷兰与英国军队围攻奥特马瑟姆。围城从10月19日持续至21日，奥特马瑟姆的西班牙守军在总督奥托·范·登·桑德率领下投降，随后围城方占领该城。
zh.n: 本条目记录的是资料框所列的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of Sekigahara (Shinjitai: 関ヶ原の戦い; Kyūjitai: 關ヶ原の戰い Sekigahara no Tatakai) was a decisive battle on October 21, 1600 (Keichō 5, 15th day of the 9th month) that preceded the establishment of the Tokugawa shogunate. Tokugawa Ieyasu took three more years to consolidate his position of power over the Toyotomi clan and the daimyo, but Sekigahara is widely considered to be the unofficial beginning of the Tokugawa bakufu, the last shogunate to control Japan. Japan had a long period of peace after the battle.

zh.s: 关原之战于1600年10月21日（庆长五年九月十五日）爆发，是德川幕府建立前的一场决定性战役。德川家康又用了三年巩固自己对丰臣氏和各地大名的统治地位，但关原之战普遍被视为德川幕府（最后一个统治日本的幕府）的非正式开端。战后，日本经历了长期和平。

en.s: The siege of Tabriz (Persian: فتح تبریز) was a military conflict during the Ottoman–Safavid war of 1603–1612. As a result of a successful Persian siege initiated by Shah Abbas the Great, Tabriz was returned to the Safavids after 18 years of Ottoman rule.

zh.t: 萨法维王朝攻占大不里士（1603年）
zh.s: 大不里士围城战（波斯语：فتح تبریز）是1603至1612年奥斯曼—萨法维战争期间的一场军事冲突。阿拔斯大帝发起的波斯围城行动取得成功，结束了奥斯曼帝国对大不里士长达18年的统治，萨法维王朝重新夺回该城。

en.s: The Battle of the Downs took place on 21 October 1639 (New Style), during the Eighty Years' War. A Spanish fleet, commanded by Admiral Antonio de Oquendo, was decisively defeated by a Dutch force under Lieutenant-Admiral Maarten Tromp. Victory ended Spanish efforts to re-assert naval control over the English Channel and confirmed Dutch dominance of the sea lanes, while it is also alleged to be the first major action to feature line of battle tactics.

zh.s: 唐斯海战于新历1639年10月21日在八十年战争期间爆发。安东尼奥·德·奥肯多上将指挥的西班牙舰队被马尔滕·特龙普中将率领的荷兰舰队决定性击败。此胜利终结了西班牙重新控制英吉利海峡的努力，并确立荷兰对海上航线的优势。另有说法称，这是首次采用战列线战术的重要海战。

en.s: (See also: Battle of Annan) The Battle of Annan Moor was a battle of the Scottish civil war, part of the intertwined Wars of the Three Kingdoms that took place in England, Ireland, and Scotland between 1639 and 1651. The battle took place on 20 and 21 October 1645 between the Royalists under Lord Digby and Marmaduke Langdale against the newly raised cavalry regiment commanded by Sir John Brown of Fordell. The Royalists were defeated and lost more than half of their 600 men as casualties or prisoners. The remainder of the Royalist force retired into England.

zh.s: 安南沼泽战役是苏格兰内战的一场战斗，属于1639年至1651年间在英格兰、爱尔兰和苏格兰发生的三王国战争。战斗于1645年10月20日至21日进行，迪格比勋爵和马默杜克·兰代尔率领保王党，对阵约翰·布朗爵士新组建的骑兵团。保王党战败，600人中超过一半伤亡或被俘，余部撤入英格兰。

en.t: Russian troops attack the Lithuanian camp at Verkiai
en.s: On October 21, 1658, Russian troops attacked the Lithuanian camp at Verkiai near Vilnius and captured commander Wincenty Gosiewski.

zh.t: 俄军突袭韦尔基艾的立陶宛军营
zh.s: 1658年10月21日，俄军突袭维尔纽斯附近韦尔基艾的立陶宛军营，俘虏指挥官温岑蒂·戈谢夫斯基。

en.s: The siege of Negroponte (modern Chalkis) was undertaken by the forces of the Republic of Venice from July to October 1688. The Venetian army, composed of several mercenary and allied contingents from western Europe, had succeeded in capturing the Peloponnese in the previous years, and proceeded to capture Athens and attack Negroponte, the main Ottoman stronghold in Central Greece.

zh.s: 威尼斯共和国军队于1688年7月至10月围攻尼格罗蓬特（今哈尔基斯）。威尼斯军队由数支来自西欧的雇佣军和盟军组成。此前几年，威尼斯军队已成功攻占伯罗奔尼撒，随后继续攻占雅典并进攻尼格罗蓬特——奥斯曼帝国在希腊中部的主要据点。

en.s: The Battle at The Lizard (French: Combat du Cap Lézard) took place on 21 October 1707 during the War of the Spanish Succession near Lizard Point, Cornwall between two French squadrons under René Duguay-Trouin and Claude de Forbin and a British convoy protected by a squadron under Commodore Richard Edwards. Duguay-Trouin and Forbin were two of the most successful French naval commanders and they caused much damage to the British merchant fleet.

zh.s: 蜥蜴角海战（法语：Combat du Cap Lézard）于1707年10月21日在西班牙王位继承战争期间爆发，地点在康沃尔郡蜥蜴角附近。勒内·迪盖-特鲁安和克洛德·德·福尔班率领两支法国舰队，与理查德·爱德华兹准将率领、负责保护一支商船队的英国舰队交战。迪盖-特鲁安和福尔班是法国最成功的海军指挥官之一，此战使英国商船队遭受重大损失。

en.s: The Battle of Cap-Français was a naval engagement during the Seven Years' War fought between French and British forces outside the harbour of Cap-Français, Saint-Domingue (present-day Cap-Haïtien, Haiti) on 21 October 1757. The British force, consisting of three ships of the line under Commodore Arthur Forrest had been sent to cruise off Saint-Domingue in the hope of intercepting a French merchant convoy bound for France, but found that the convoy's escort, under Guy François de Coetnempren, comte de Kersaint, had been heavily reinforced. The French came out to drive the British away, whereupon the British ships attacked them.

zh.s: 卡普弗朗赛海战是七年战争期间法国与英国军队在圣多明各（今海地海地角）卡普弗朗赛港外进行的一场海战，发生于1757年10月21日。亚瑟·福雷斯特准将率领三艘战列舰组成的英国舰队奉命在圣多明各附近巡航，希望拦截一支驶往法国的法国商船队，却发现由居伊·弗朗索瓦·德·科特内姆普兰、凯尔桑伯爵率领的护航舰队已大幅增援。法军出港驱逐英舰，英国舰只随即发动攻击。

en.s: The siege of Mainz was a short engagement at the beginning of the War of the First Coalition. The victorious French army of Custine seized the town on October 21, 1792, after three days of siege. The French occupied Mainz, and tried to install the Republic of Mainz there.

zh.s: 美因茨围城战是第一次反法同盟战争初期的一场短暂交战。1792年10月21日，库斯蒂纳率领的法军围城三天后攻占该城。法军占领美因茨，并试图在那里建立美因茨共和国。

en.s: The Action of 21 October 1794 was a minor naval engagement between Great Britain and France fought off the Breton coast of France during the second year of the French Revolutionary Wars. French frigates had been raiding British Atlantic trade routes with considerable success since the outbreak of the war, and in response the Admiralty had formed a frigate squadron to patrol the French Channel and Atlantic coasts in search of French raiders. On 13 October 1794, the large, modern and powerful 40-gun French frigate Révolutionnaire under the command of Captain Antoine René Thévenard sailed from Le Havre for a raiding cruise against British trade routes in the Atlantic.

zh.s: 1794年10月21日，第二次反法同盟战争的第二年，英国与法国在法国布列塔尼海岸附近发生小规模海战。法国护卫舰自战争爆发以来屡次袭击英国大西洋贸易航线。为此，英国海军部组建护卫舰分舰队，在英吉利海峡和大西洋沿岸巡逻，搜寻法国袭击船只。1794年10月13日，法国一艘大型、现代化的40炮护卫舰“革命者”号从勒阿弗尔出发，由安托万-勒内·泰弗纳尔船长指挥，准备袭击英国大西洋贸易航线。

en.s: Legislative elections were held in France between 12 and 21 October 1795 (20 to 29 Vendémiaire, Year IV) to elect one-third of the members of the Council of Five Hundred and the Council of Ancients, the lower and upper houses of the legislature. The elections were held in accordance with the Constitution of the Year III and the first under the French Directory.

zh.s: 法国于1795年10月12日至21日（共和四年旺代米埃月20日至29日）举行立法选举，选出五百人院和元老院（立法机关的上下两院）三分之一的议员。选举依据共和三年宪法举行，也是法国督政府时期的首次选举。

en.s: On October 21, 1797, USS Constitution was launched into Boston Harbor from Edmund Hartt’s shipyard.

zh.s: 1797年10月21日，美国宪法号战舰在波士顿的埃德蒙·哈特船厂下水。

en.s: The Battle of Trafalgar was a fleet action which took place on 21 October 1805 between the Royal Navy and a combined fleet of the French and Spanish navies during the War of the Third Coalition. As part of Napoleon's planned invasion of the United Kingdom, the French and Spanish navies planned to take control of the English Channel and provide the French invasion army with safe passage to Britain.

zh.s: 特拉法加海战于1805年10月21日爆发，是第三次反法同盟战争期间，英国皇家海军与法国、西班牙联合舰队之间的一场舰队作战。作为拿破仑计划入侵英国的一部分，法国和西班牙海军计划控制英吉利海峡，为法国入侵部队安全渡海提供通道。

en.s: At the siege of Burgos, from 19 September to 21 October 1812, the Anglo-Portuguese Army led by General Arthur Wellesley, Marquess of Wellington tried to capture the castle of Burgos from its French garrison under the command of General of Brigade Jean-Louis Dubreton. The French repulsed every attempt to seize the fortress, resulting in Wellington's withdrawal. The siege took place during the Peninsular War, part of the Napoleonic Wars.

zh.s: 1812年9月19日至10月21日，亚瑟·韦尔斯利将军（惠灵顿侯爵）率领英葡联军围攻布尔戈斯，试图从让-路易·迪布勒东准将指挥的法国守军手中夺取城堡。法军击退了每次攻城尝试，惠灵顿最终撤军。此次围城发生在半岛战争期间，属于拿破仑战争的一部分。

en.s: The naval Battle of Montevideo (Portuguese: Batalha Naval de Montevidéu) of 21 October 1823 formed a part of the Siege of Montevideo, as Brazilian forces sought to capture the last Portuguese redoubt in the Cisplatina during the War of Independence of Brazil. The fight was one of the few conventional naval battles between the two powers during the war. The Portuguese forces, a captured schooner and three armed transports, had endured the Brazilian blockade of the port but only sought to break it on 21 October. Despite heavy fighting neither side lost a ship, and the Portuguese withdrew to the port, with the conflict ending a month later with the surrender of Montevideo.

zh.s: 1823年10月21日的蒙得维的亚海战（葡萄牙语：Batalha Naval de Montevidéu）是蒙得维的亚围城战的一部分。巴西军队试图在巴西独立战争期间攻占西斯普拉蒂纳最后一处葡萄牙据点。这是战争期间两国少有的常规海战之一。葡萄牙方面有一艘被俘获的纵帆船和三艘武装运输船，虽一直承受巴西对港口的封锁，直到10月21日才试图突围。双方激战，但都没有损失舰船。葡萄牙军队退回港口，一个月后蒙得维的亚投降，冲突随之结束。

en.s: The Liberal Revolution of 1854 (Spanish: Revolución Liberal de 1854), also known as the Arequipa Revolution of 1854 (Spanish: Revolución de Arequipa de 1854), was a popular insurrection that emerged in Peru during the government of José Rufino Echenique due to accusations of corruption. It was led by Domingo Elías, Fermín del Castillo and Ramón Castilla. In the aftermath of the revolution, a new constitution was written.

zh.s: 1854年自由革命（西班牙语：Revolución Liberal de 1854）又称1854年阿雷基帕革命（西班牙语：Revolución de Arequipa de 1854），是秘鲁总统何塞·鲁菲诺·埃切尼克执政期间因腐败指控而爆发的民众起义。起义由多明戈·埃利亚斯、费尔明·德尔·卡斯蒂略和拉蒙·卡斯蒂利亚领导。革命后，秘鲁制定了新宪法。

en.t: Florence Nightingale and a staff of 38 nurses and 15 nuns were sent to the Ottoman Empire to help treat wounded British soldiers fighting in the Crimean War
en.s: Florence Nightingale () (12 May 1820 – 13 August 1910) was an English social reformer, statistician and the founder of modern nursing. Nightingale came to prominence while serving as a manager and trainer of nurses during the Crimean War, in which she organised care for wounded soldiers at Constantinople. She significantly reduced death rates by improving hygiene and living standards.

zh.t: 弗洛伦斯·南丁格尔率38名护士和15名修女前往奥斯曼帝国，救治克里米亚战争中的英国伤兵
zh.s: 弗洛伦斯·南丁格尔（1820年5月12日—1910年8月13日）是英国社会改革家、统计学家，也是现代护理学的奠基人。克里米亚战争期间，她担任护士管理者和培训者，为君士坦丁堡的伤兵组织护理工作，因此广为人知。她通过改善卫生和生活条件，大幅降低了死亡率。

en.s: The Battle of Ball's Bluff in Loudoun County, Virginia on October 21, 1861, was one of the early battles of the American Civil War, in which Maj. Gen. George B. McClellan’s Army of the Potomac (Union) suffered a humiliating defeat. The operation was planned as a minor reconnaissance across the Potomac to establish whether the Confederates were occupying Leesburg. A false report of an unguarded Confederate camp encouraged Brig. Gen. Charles Pomeroy Stone to order a raid, which clashed with enemy forces. A prominent US Senator in uniform, Colonel Edward Baker, tried to reinforce the Union troops, but failed to ensure that there were enough boats for the river crossings, which were then delayed.

zh.s: 1861年10月21日，弗吉尼亚州劳登县发生巴尔斯布拉夫战役。这是美国内战早期的一场战斗，乔治·B·麦克莱伦少将率领的联邦军波托马克军团遭遇惨败。联邦军原计划派小股部队渡过波托马克河侦察，确认李斯堡是否有南方邦联军驻守。一则称邦联军营地无人看守的错误报告促使查尔斯·波默罗伊·斯通准将下令突袭，结果与敌军交战。身着军装的美国参议员、上校爱德华·贝克试图增援联邦军，但未能确保渡河船只充足，渡河因此延误。

en.s: The Battle of Camp Wildcat (also known as Wildcat Mountain and Camp Wild Cat) was one of the early engagements of the American Civil War (Civil War). It occurred October 21, 1861, in northern Laurel County, Kentucky during the campaign known as the Kentucky Confederate Offensive or Operations in Eastern Kentucky (1861).

zh.s: 坎普野猫战役又称野猫山战役或野猫营战役，是美国内战早期的一场交战，于1861年10月21日在肯塔基州劳雷尔县北部发生，属于肯塔基邦联攻势或东肯塔基行动（1861年）的一部分。

en.s: Engagement at Fredericktown, also known as the Battle of Fredericktown, was a battle of the American Civil War that took place on October 21, 1861, in Madison County, Missouri. The Union victory consolidated control of southeastern Missouri.

zh.s: 弗雷德里克敦交战又称弗雷德里克敦战役，是美国内战期间的一场战斗，于1861年10月21日在密苏里州麦迪逊县发生。联邦军获胜后，巩固了对密苏里州东南部的控制。

en.s: The Battle of Cherokee Station took place during the American Civil War between the Union Army and the Confederate Army near the town of Cherokee Station Alabama on 21 October 1863. General Sherman attempted to start rebuilding the Memphis and Charleston Railroad to give Union forces an easier time to arrive at Chattanooga from Mississippi. Sherman initiated his reconstruction at Corinth, Mississippi and began to push into northern Alabama.

zh.s: 美国内战期间，联邦军和邦联军于1863年10月21日在阿拉巴马州切罗基站镇附近交战。谢尔曼将军试图重建孟菲斯—查尔斯顿铁路，让联邦军更容易从密西西比州抵达查塔努加。他在密西西比州科林斯开始重建铁路，并开始向阿拉巴马州北部推进。

en.s: The Battle of Little Blue River was a minor battle of the American Civil War, occurring on October 21, 1864 in Jackson County, Missouri during Price's Missouri Expedition of that year. It became the opening round of the Second Battle of Independence, which began on this same day and was essentially a continuation of this engagement. This led in turn to the Battle of Westport on October 23, resulting in Price's defeat and the ending of major Confederate military operations in Missouri.

zh.s: 小蓝河战役是美国内战期间的一场小规模战斗，于1864年10月21日在密苏里州杰克逊县发生，属于当年的普赖斯密苏里远征。这场战斗拉开了第二次独立城战役的序幕；后者于同日开始，实质上是小蓝河战役的延续。随后，10月23日爆发韦斯特波特战役，普赖斯战败，邦联军在密苏里州的大规模军事行动也就此结束。

en.s: The Medicine Lodge Treaty is the overall name for three treaties signed near Medicine Lodge, Kansas, between the Federal government of the United States and southern Plains Indian tribes in October 1867, intended to bring peace to the area by relocating the Native Americans to reservations in Indian Territory and away from European-American settlement. The treaty was negotiated after investigation by the Indian Peace Commission, which in its final report in 1868 concluded that the wars had been preventable. They determined that the United States government and its representatives, including the United States Congress, had contributed to the warfare on the Great Plains by failing to fulfill their legal obligations and to treat the Native Americans with honesty. The U.S. government and tribal chiefs met at a place traditional for Native American ceremonies, at their request. The first treaty was signed October 21, 1867, with the Kiowa and Comanche tribes.

zh.s: 梅迪辛洛奇条约是1867年10月美国联邦政府与南部大平原原住民部族在堪萨斯州梅迪辛洛奇附近签署的三项条约的统称。条约旨在通过将原住民迁往印第安领地的保留地，使其远离欧洲裔美国人的定居点，以实现该地区和平。印度和平委员会调查后进行谈判；该委员会在1868年的最终报告中认定，战争本可避免，并指出美国政府及其代表（包括国会）未履行法律义务、未诚实对待原住民，助长了大平原地区的战事。应原住民要求，美国政府和部族首领在一处传统仪式地点会面。第一项条约于1867年10月21日与基奥瓦族和科曼奇族签署。

en.s: The Battle of Tatayibá was a cavalry engagement between a Paraguayan force led by future president Bernardino Caballero and a Brazilian force led by Luís Alves de Lima e Silva, then Marquis of Caxias. The Brazilians, outnumbering the Paraguayans nearly 3 to 2, were victorious. A trap was set by the Brazilian cavalry in order to stop the daily sorties by Lt. Col. Caballero's Paraguayan cavalry.

zh.s: 塔泰伊巴之战是巴拉圭军队与巴西军队之间的一场骑兵战。巴拉圭军队由后来成为总统的贝尔纳迪诺·卡瓦列罗率领，巴西军队则由当时的卡西亚斯侯爵路易斯·阿尔维斯·德·利马·埃·席尔瓦指挥。巴西军人数几乎是巴拉圭军队的1.5倍，最终获胜。巴西骑兵设下埋伏，试图阻止卡瓦列罗中校的巴拉圭骑兵每天出击。

en.s: The (First) Battle of Buzenval took place on 21 October 1870 during the siege of Paris in the Franco-Prussian War. Following the collapse of the French field armies and the encirclement of Paris, Governor Louis-Jules Trochu authorised a limited sortie to test Prussian positions west of the capital.

zh.s: 第一次布藏瓦尔战役于1870年10月21日在普法战争期间的巴黎围城战中爆发。法国野战军溃败、巴黎被包围后，巴黎总督路易-朱尔·特罗许批准进行一次有限出击，以试探首都西侧的普鲁士军阵地。

en.s: The Battle of Cedar Creek (also called Big Dry Creek or Big Dry River) occurred on October 21, 1876, in the Montana Territory between the United States Army and a force of Lakota Sioux Native Americans during the Great Sioux War of 1876. The battle broke out after talks between Colonel Nelson A. Miles and Chief Sitting Bull broke down, and ended with surrender of 400 Lakota lodges (with approximately 2,000 men, women, and children) to Miles six days later.

zh.s: 雪松溪战役又称大干溪战役或大干河战役，于1876年10月21日在蒙大拿领地爆发，交战双方是美国陆军和拉科塔苏族原住民部队，属于1876年大苏族战争。纳尔逊·A·迈尔斯上校与坐牛酋长谈判破裂后，战斗爆发。六天后，约400个拉科塔营帐（约有2,000名男女老幼）向迈尔斯投降。

en.s: The Capitulation of Tainan, on 21 October 1895, was the last act in the Japanese invasion of Taiwan. The capitulation ended the brief existence of the Republic of Formosa and inaugurated the era of Japanese colonial rule in Taiwan.

zh.s: 台南受降发生于1895年10月21日，是日本入侵台湾的最后一幕。受降结束了短暂存在的台湾民主国，并开启日本在台湾的殖民统治时期。

en.t: The fall of Tainan on 21 October 1895 ended organised resistance to Japanese occupation, and inaugurated five decades of Japanese rule in Taiwan
en.s: The Republic of Formosa was a short-lived unrecognized state that existed on the island of Taiwan in 1895 during the interregnum between the formal cession of Taiwan by the Qing dynasty of China to the Empire of Japan after the Treaty of Shimonoseki. The Republic lasted for 151 days; it was proclaimed on 23 May 1895 and extinguished on 21 October, when its capital of Tainan was taken over by the Japanese and they established control on the island.

zh.s: 1895年10月21日，台南陷落，结束了台湾有组织的抵抗，也开启了日本对台湾长达五十年的统治。台湾民主国是1895年存在于台湾岛上的短命、未获承认的国家，处于清朝依据《马关条约》正式将台湾割让给日本之后的过渡时期。该国存续151天，于1895年5月23日宣布成立，并在日军接管其首都台南、控制全岛后于10月21日灭亡。

en.s: The Battle of Elandslaagte (21 October 1899) took place during the Second Boer War, and was one of the few decisive victories won by the British during the conflict. At the time, the Boers were invading Natal, and had occupied the railway station at Elandslaagte. To dispel the Boers from their position, the British Army led a two-pronged assault in the hills which the Boers occupied, forcing them to retreat.

zh.s: 埃兰兹拉赫特战役发生于1899年10月21日，是第二次布尔战争期间英国取得的少数决定性胜利之一。当时布尔人入侵纳塔尔并占领埃兰兹拉赫特火车站。为将布尔人逐出阵地，英国陆军从两路进攻他们占据的山地，迫使其撤退。

en.s: The 1907 Qaratog earthquake occurred at 04:23 UTC on 21 October near Qaratog (Karatag) in the border area between Uzbekistan and Tajikistan, then part of the Russian Empire. The shock had an estimated surface-wave magnitude of 7.4 and a maximum felt intensity of IX (Violent) on the Mercalli intensity scale. Estimates of the death toll range between 12,000 and 15,000.
en.n: The 1907 Qaratog earthquake hits the borders of Uzbekistan and Tajikistan, killing between 12,000 and 15,000 people.

zh.s: 1907年10月21日世界协调时04:23，卡拉托格（卡拉塔格）附近发生地震，震中位于当时属于俄罗斯帝国、今乌兹别克斯坦与塔吉克斯坦交界地区。地震面波震级估计为7.4级，麦加利烈度最高达到IX级（剧烈）。死亡人数估计在12,000至15,000人之间。

en.s: The Battle of Kircaali or Battle of Kardzhali was part of the First Balkan War between the armies of Bulgaria and the Ottoman Empire. It took place on 21 October 1912, when the Bulgarian Haskovo Detachment defeated the Ottoman Kırcaali Detachment of Yaver Pasha and permanently joined Kardzhali and the Eastern Rhodopes to Bulgaria. The anniversary of that event is celebrated annually on 21 October as a holiday of the city.

zh.s: 克尔贾利战役又称柯尔贾利战役，是第一次巴尔干战争期间保加利亚与奥斯曼帝国军队之间的一场战斗。1912年10月21日，保加利亚哈斯科沃支队击败亚韦尔帕夏率领的奥斯曼克尔贾利支队，并使克尔贾利和东罗多彼山脉地区永久并入保加利亚。此后，该事件周年日每年作为城市节日庆祝。

en.s: The Capture of Lemnos took place in October 1912 during the First Balkan War, serving as the opening action between Greek and Ottoman forces in the Aegean Sea. The strategic value of the island of Lemnos had been recognized by Greek naval planners for many years, as it lay at the entrance of the Dardanelles Strait and offered an excellent natural harbour in Mudros Bay.

en.t: Australian occupation of German New Guinea
en.s: The Australian occupation of German New Guinea occurred in the early stages of World War I when the colony was seized by the Australian Naval and Military Expeditionary Force. The colony of German New Guinea was poorly defended and the invasion met with limited resistance, with the Battle of Bita Paka in September 1914 being the only major engagement. Australian forces subsequently seized the island of Nauru in November 1914.

zh.t: 澳大利亚占领德属新几内亚

en.t: Japanese occupation of German colonial possessions
en.s: Japan entered World War I in 1914 with the strategic objective of expanding its influence in the Pacific region by seizing German-controlled colonies. In October 1914, the Japanese sent vessels to occupy German-held territories in the Pacific. This included the Mariana Islands, Marshall Islands, Palau, and Caroline Islands.

en.s: The Ojo de Agua Raid was the last notable military engagement between Mexican Sediciosos and the United States Army. It took place at Ojo de Agua, Texas. As part of the Plan of San Diego, the rebels launched a raid across the Rio Grande into Texas on October 21, 1915 aimed at harassing the American outposts along the Mexican border and disrupting the local economy.

zh.s: 奥霍德阿瓜突袭是墨西哥起义武装与美国陆军之间最后一次值得注意的军事交战，地点在得克萨斯州奥霍德阿瓜。作为圣迭戈计划的一部分，叛军于1915年10月21日越过格兰德河突袭得克萨斯州，企图骚扰美墨边境沿线的美国哨所，并扰乱当地经济。

en.s: The Hvalen incident was a short and small-scale confrontation between the navies of Sweden and Germany as a consequence of the First World War. The Swedish submarine Hvalen would be mistook for an enemy vessel and fired upon while out on patrol, one Swedish sailor would perish as a consequence. However, the naval skirmish would not escalate any further as the powers involved would solve their problems diplomatically.

zh.s: “鲸”号事件是第一次世界大战期间瑞典与德国海军之间一次短暂、小规模的冲突。瑞典潜艇“鲸”号在巡逻时被误认为敌舰并遭到射击，一名瑞典水兵因此丧生。不过，双方通过外交途径解决了问题，海上冲突没有进一步升级。

en.s: The Macedonian front, also known as the Salonica front (after Thessaloniki), was a military theatre of World War I formed as a result of an attempt by the Allied Powers to aid Serbia, in the autumn of 1915, against the combined attack of Germany, Austria-Hungary and Bulgaria. On 29 October 1941, Felix Benzler, the plenipotentiary of the German foreign ministry in Serbia, reported that 2,300 people were executed. Later investigations by the post-war Yugoslavian government came up with between 5,000 and 7,000 people executed, although these figures were never proven reliable.

en.s: The Mau Mau rebellion (1952–1960), also known as the Mau Mau uprising or Kenya Emergency, was an armed conflict in the British Colony of Kenya between the Kenya Land and Freedom Army (KLFA) and the British colonial authorities. While the KLFA was primarily composed of Kikuyu, Meru, and Embu fighters, the movement also drew support from units of Kamba and Maasai. Groups such as the Luo and Kalenjin – who had led significant earlier resistance movements against colonial establishment, such as the Nandi Resistance (1890–1906) were largely not part of the KLFA's core structure. Instead, many from these communities served in the King's African Rifles (KAR), the colonial military force through which the British maintained internal security and quelled the uprising. The KLFA fought against the British Army and the local Kenya Regiment, which included European settlers and African loyalists. The capture of Field Marshal Dedan Kimathi on 21 October 1956 signalled the defeat of the Mau Mau, and essentially ended the British military campaign.

zh.s: 茅茅起义（1952—1960年）又称茅茅暴动或肯尼亚紧急状态，是英国殖民地肯尼亚境内肯尼亚土地与自由军（KLFA）与英国殖民当局之间的武装冲突。KLFA主要由基库尤人、梅鲁人和恩布人战士组成，也得到坎巴人和马赛人部队的支持。卢奥人和卡伦金人等群体曾较早抵抗殖民统治，例如南迪人抵抗运动（1890—1906年），但大多不属于KLFA的核心组织；这些群体中的许多人加入了国王非洲步枪队（KAR），这支殖民军队负责英国殖民当局的内部治安并镇压起义。KLFA与英国陆军及当地肯尼亚团作战，该团成员包括欧洲裔定居者和效忠殖民当局的非洲人。1956年10月21日，陆军元帅德丹·基马蒂被捕，这标志着茅茅运动的失败，也基本结束了英国的军事行动。

en.s: The Aberfan disaster was the catastrophic collapse of a colliery spoil tip in the Welsh village of Aberfan, near Merthyr Tydfil, that killed 116 children and 28 adults on 21 October 1966. The collapse was caused by the build-up of water in the accumulated rock and shale tip, which suddenly slid downhill in the form of slurry. More than 1.4 million cubic feet (40,000 cu metres) of debris covered the village in minutes. The classrooms at Pantglas Junior School were immediately inundated; young children and teachers died from impact or suffocation.

zh.s: 1966年10月21日，威尔士阿伯凡村附近一处煤矿废渣堆突然坍塌，造成灾难性事故，116名儿童和28名成年人遇难。堆积的岩石和页岩中水分不断增加，最终形成泥浆般的滑流冲下山坡。超过140万立方英尺（4万立方米）的废料在几分钟内覆盖村庄。潘特格拉斯小学教室很快被淹没，年幼学生和教师因撞击或窒息死亡。

en.s: The 1969 Somali coup d'état was a bloodless military takeover of the Somali Republic on 21 October 1969, led by Somali National Army officers of the Supreme Revolutionary Council under General Siad Barre. After the assassination of President Abdirashid Shermarke in Las Anod, the Somali National Army under Barre's command stormed Mogadishu, seized key government buildings, and demanded the resignation of the country's leaders.

en.s: The Clarkston explosion was a disaster that occurred on 21 October 1971 at a shopping centre in Clarkston, Renfrewshire, Scotland. The death toll has been stated variously as 21 and 22. The explosion followed a build-up of gas in an underground space beneath the Clarkston Toll shopping centre, caused by a gas main leak later ruled to have been accidental. Customers and shop staff had on 20 October complained of a strong smell of gas in the centre and Scottish Gas engineers had attended to investigate, but had identified no source for the smell.

zh.s: 克拉克斯顿爆炸事故发生于1971年10月21日，地点是苏格兰伦弗鲁郡克拉克斯顿的一家购物中心。事故死亡人数有21人和22人两种说法。克拉克斯顿收费站购物中心下方的地下空间积聚燃气，随后发生爆炸；调查认定，燃气主管道泄漏是意外事故。10月20日，顾客和商店员工已抱怨中心内有强烈燃气味，苏格兰燃气公司的工程师到场检查，却没有找到气味来源。

en.s: The 1971 Ontario general election was held on October 21, 1971, to elect the 117 members of the 29th Legislative Assembly of Ontario (Members of Provincial Parliament, or "MPPs") of the Province of Ontario. en.s: The 1984 Portuguese Grand Prix was a Formula One motor race held at Estoril on October 21, 1984. It was the sixteenth and final round of the 1984 Formula One season. This was the first Formula One championship Portuguese Grand Prix since 1960, when it was held at the Boavista street circuit in Oporto. Niki Lauda needed 2nd place to secure the title, and gained this when Nigel Mansell spun out with 18 laps to go. As a result, he took the title by just half a point from team-mate Alain Prost.

zh.s: 1984年葡萄牙大奖赛是1984年10月21日在埃斯托里尔举行的一场一级方程式赛车比赛，也是1984赛季的第16站暨收官站。这是自1960年以来首次举办计入一级方程式锦标赛的葡萄牙大奖赛；1960年的比赛在波尔图的博阿维斯塔街道赛道举行。尼基·劳达只需获得第二名即可确保总冠军；在比赛还剩18圈时，奈杰尔·曼塞尔打滑退赛，劳达因此达到所需名次。他最终仅以半分优势击败队友阿兰·普罗斯特夺冠。

en.s: TAN-SAHSA Flight 414 was a scheduled flight from Juan Santamaría International Airport, San José, Costa Rica, to Toncontín Airport in Tegucigalpa, Honduras, with a stopover at Augusto C. Sandino Airport in Managua, Nicaragua, on 21 October 1989. Flown with a Boeing 727-200, the flight crashed into a mountain at 7:30 A.M. local time after the pilots failed to follow a special landing procedure required for the arrival to the airport.

en.s: A general election was held between Saturday, 20 October and Sunday, 21 October 1990 for members of the 8th Parliament of Malaysia. Voting took place in all 180 parliamentary constituencies of Malaysia, each electing one Member of Parliament to the Dewan Rakyat, the dominant house of Parliament. State elections also took place in 351 state constituencies in 11 (out of 13, except Sabah and Sarawak) states of Malaysia on the same day. The result was a victory for the Barisan Nasional (BN) at the federal level and 10 of the 11 state elections.

en.s: The 1991 Saskatchewan general election was held on October 21, 1991, to elect members of the Legislative Assembly of Saskatchewan. en.s: The Burundian Civil War was a civil war in Burundi lasting from 1993 to 2005. The civil war was the result of longstanding ethnic divisions between the Hutu and the Tutsi ethnic groups. en.s: The Seongsu Bridge disaster (Korean: 성수대교 붕괴 사고) was a deadly bridge collapse that occurred on the morning of October 21, 1994 in Seoul, South Korea. 32 people died and 17 were injured when a section of the upper truss of the Seongsu Bridge collapsed onto the Han River. A combination of faulty welding, rusted extension hinges, and insufficient maintenance resulted in the structural failure of the bridge.

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Poland on 21 October 2007, after the Sejm voted for its own dissolution on 7 September.
